scopeNotes: Full regression ran before three final CLI/interruption/missing-command tests and the decision resume hint were added.
Final node regression reran all 15 workflow integration cases and all 3 core runner cases, including those final changes.
Coverage combines the full run with only the 3 new tests. The other final node cases overlap and are not added twice.
Initial focused failures were invalid fixtures: fixRounds below the minimum, then a test strategy referencing an undeclared command. Corrected and rechecked.
The 4 platform skips are existing Windows case-sensitive filename and Unix permission tests.
limitations: No new live Claude Code interaction or token/time savings measurement.
Parallel sessions mutating the same work are not validated.
Agent and human nodes return handoffs; they do not invoke a model or fabricate approvals.
